findings.detail: Observer captures DMG archive path/bytes/hash/time but not submission_id; verify-host.py requires dmg_capture['submission_id']==args.dmg_submission_id.
findings.action: Resolve exact current submission ID from frozen release-build.log and bind it to this captured current pre-staple DMG record; Apple log SHA must match. No old job reuse.

findings.detail: An unexpected observer exception does not terminate the child release subprocess. Finalize will reject missing evidence, but the child may continue creating a draft.
findings.action: If observer fails, explicitly inspect/reap the child and do not treat detached execution as observed. No need to interrupt successful current execution.

findings.detail: Tracked source and dist hashes are captured and finalized, but actual PATH transport shim and executable tool versions are not recorded in the manifest. Local Moraya dist comparison is separately recorded.
findings.action: Record actual tool versions and transport shim hashes if adding environment provenance. Retain trusted-build/non-hermetic boundary.
